result_explanation: Criterion 1/6 fails: although the required greeting, disclosure, and immediate California question are present, Alice says, “I'm guessing you're reaching out because you're having issues with your vehicle,” which is prohibited by the criteria. The remaining criteria are met: she asks for text/email consent, correctly follows the non-retainer booking-link path after the caller declines transfer, does not speak internal routing text, does not redundantly ask for provided information, and uses the caller’s name only for the permitted driver’s-license check.

metrics: The greeting is "Thanks for calling Knight Law Group, this is Alice." with the AI/recording disclosure, ending "…so let me get a little information about the car.", then straight into the California question. It does NOT include the caller's name and does NOT ask "Are you having issues with your vehicle?".
After the email is read back, Alice ASKS whether it is okay for the team to reach the caller by text and email (inbound keeps the consent question).
The lead is treated as non-retainer (Toyota): no agreement is sent, and the call ends on the consultation booking-link close (after the caller declines a live transfer, if one is offered).
Alice never reads stage directions, node names, variable names, lead classifications or routing logic aloud (ignore tool_call / tool_call_result lines, they are not spoken).
Alice never asks for the same piece of information twice after the caller has clearly given it.

The opening is the greeting with the AI/recording disclosure, ending "…so let me get a little information about the car." (or the Spanish equivalent), followed straight away by the California purchase question. Alice never asks "Mind if I ask you a couple of quick questions?" or "Are you having any issues with your vehicle?".

Before any hand-off to the retainer agent: apart from the one driver's-license name check (where she reads the name on file once), Alice never says the caller's name, including in the line where she says the agreement was sent. (After the hand-off the retainer agent may use the name.)

test_case_definition_snapshot.userPrompt: You are Paula Test, calling Knight Law Group yourself about your car. When the call connects, say "Hi, I'm calling about my car." and wait for Alice. California: "Yes, I bought it in San Diego." If asked purchase or lease: "I bought it." You still have it. Your car is a 2022 Toyota Camry; give it when asked and confirm her read-back. Your name is Paula Test (it matches your license); if she spells it, say yes. Your email paula.test@acme.ai is right, and texts and emails are fine. If she offers to connect you with someone now, say "No thanks, just send me the link." Keep every reply short and natural, like a real person on the phone (one sentence, often just a few words). Answer only what she asks unless the script below says otherwise. When the call is clearly over, say goodbye.
